sentenceSets.sentence: His irascible reaction to minor inconveniences made subordinates reluctant to bring him genuinely difficult news.

answerChoices.reasoning: Testy names a passing crankiness on a bad day, but the sentence describes something steady enough that his staff arranged their behavior around it.
Peevish suggests fretful complaining, which would be tiresome rather than something people avoid risking with important news.
Volatile implies nobody could predict him, yet the sentence says subordinates knew exactly what to expect even from small annoyances.
Exacting would mean he demanded high standards of work, while the trigger the sentence names is inconvenience rather than poor performance.
Impatience is provoked by delay, but the sentence points to inconveniences of every minor kind.
Brusque describes a curt way of speaking, which would be unpleasant without making people afraid to deliver bad news.
Domineering concerns controlling others, and the sentence's subject is how he takes small setbacks rather than how he runs people.
Critical would mean he found fault with the work, whereas the sentence's inconveniences are things that happen to him, not things his staff produced.
A placid manner would encourage subordinates to bring him difficult news rather than deter them.
Geniality would make him easy to approach, contradicting the reluctance the sentence describes.
Forgiving is the opposite of a reaction that makes people wary of speaking to him.

sentenceSets.sentence: The landlord was so irascible that tenants learned to slide the rent under his door rather than knock.

answerChoices.reasoning: Cantankerous stresses a quarrelsome stubbornness over small points, but the tenants are avoiding any encounter at all rather than avoiding arguments.
Surly is sullen unfriendliness, which would make a landlord unpleasant to meet but not something tenants rearrange their routine to escape.
Gruff describes a rough voice and blunt manner that often covers goodwill, while these tenants take real trouble never to face him.
Belligerent implies he went looking for fights, whereas the sentence leaves him at home behind a door nobody wants to knock on.
Miserliness concerns holding on to money, and the tenants are handing money over, not trying to get any from him.
Reclusive would mean he avoided people, but the sentence describes tenants avoiding him.
Suspicion would make him check on his tenants more, not make them slip the rent under the door to escape notice.
Intimidating describes the effect he has without saying what in him produces it, and the sentence turns on the reception a knock would get.
A hospitable landlord would be one tenants were glad to knock on.
Affability would make the door something to approach rather than to slide an envelope beneath.
A meek landlord would give tenants no reason to avoid him.

sentenceSets.sentence: Even his admirers concede that the composer was irascible in rehearsal, sacking three concertmasters in a single season.

answerChoices.reasoning: Temperamental implies moods that swing unpredictably, but the sentence reports a consistent pattern in rehearsal that even his defenders acknowledge.
Imperious describes command that expects obedience as a matter of course, while dismissing three players in one season points to flare-ups rather than settled authority.
Petulant suggests a childish sulk, which would not cost three musicians their jobs.
Vindictive implies revenge for specific injuries, whereas the sentence describes how he behaved in rehearsal generally.
Demanding concerns the standards he set, and admirers would concede that readily rather than as an embarrassment.
Autocratic describes who holds power in the room, which every conductor does by design.
Mercurial means changeable in mood, yet the sentence describes a reliable pattern across a whole season.
Impossible is a loose complaint that says nothing about what led to three dismissals in particular.
Patience would not be something admirers had to concede, nor would it end in sackings.
Indulgence toward players contradicts three of them being dismissed in a single season.
Serenity in rehearsal would give his admirers nothing to apologize for.
